Based on your experience at the AP® Reading with student responses, what advice would you offer 
teachers to help them improve the student performance on the exam? 

•
Teachers could emphasize how information given in the question can be used to create a mental picture of the
solution curve. In this case, because the prompt stated that M is increasing and
